name: Hame Ochi Hitozuma Nurse ~Wasuretakute mo Karada wa Oboeteiru Mazo Mesu no Honshou~
original_name: ハメ堕ち人妻ナース 〜忘れたくても体は覚えているマゾ牝の本性〜
source:
When Kana was attending a nursing school, she met Kousuke and began dating him. After gradating and working at a hospital for a year, the two got married. With her earnest, cheerful, and friendly personality......She was living a fulfilling life.

At her hospital, emergency patients are not uncommon――

However, one night......The emergency patient that comes to the hospital is someone whom she met when she was a student, before meeting Kousuke, a man she was dating, Takigawa Daiki. Although being his lover is just a [i]façade[/i]. Because in fact, she was an outlet for his desires, treated as a sex slave――

But for all that dark periods in her life which she keeps hidden, there is one thing in her current life that is a dissatisfaction, her sexual desire. Her body feeling flustered, unable to resist her lust, and wanting her desire to be fulfilled, Kana returns to being Daiki's sex slave once again.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1270540]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
当加奈在护士学校上学时，她遇到了浩介并开始与他约会。毕业并在医院工作一年后，两人结婚了。性格认真、开朗、友善……她过着充实的生活。

在她的医院里，急诊病人并不少见——

然而，有一天晚上……来到医院的急诊病人是她学生时代认识的人，之后又遇到了正在交往的男子泷川大辉。虽然成为他的爱人只是一个[i]门面[/i]。因为事实上，她是他欲望的发泄口，被当作性奴隶——

但尽管她隐藏着生活中的所有黑暗时期，但她目前的生活中有一件事是不满意的，那就是她的性欲。身体感到慌乱，无法抗拒自己的欲望，想要实现自己的欲望，假名再次回到大辉的性奴隶。
